scope: Direction-only command-execution feasibility audit for the existing v2 JSON-16 trace. This is not a shuffled qualification result and does not make a safe-decode claim from validated replay.
calculation: command_rate = output_GBps * 1_000_000_000 / average_output_bytes_per_command; ns_per_command = average_output_bytes_per_command / output_GBps. Rounded input GB/s values bound the precision of every derived number.
decision: Do not run another same-trace v2 copy-loop micro-optimization without a profiler finding or a grouped command-format prototype. A prevalidated grouped executor must exceed 352.350 M commands/s before it can be considered a necessary (not sufficient) route to a 10 GB/s safe decoder. Validation remains inside every public safe-decode measurement.
